sql: SELECT T1."Character Name" FROM characters T1 JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='Batman' ORDER BY T1.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T3.Title FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T2.Name='Tom Cruise'
SELECT T1."Character Name" FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T2.Name='Tom Cruise' AND T3.Title='Born on the Fourth of July'
SELECT AVG(T3.Rating) FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T2.Name='Tom Cruise'

SELECT (MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(T1.screentime,3,2) AS REAL)) - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T1.screentime,3,2) AS REAL))) * 100 / MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T1.screentime,3,2) AS REAL)) FROM characters T1 JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='Batman'
SELECT T1."Character Name" FROM characters T1 JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Genre='Thriller' AND T1.creditOrder=1 ORDER BY T3.Rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.Name FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='Batman' ORDER BY T1.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2."Birth City" FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1."Character Name"='Gabriel Martin'
SELECT T2.Name FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='American Hustle' AND T1.creditOrder=2
SELECT T2.Name FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3."Release Date"='2015-10-26' AND T1.creditOrder=1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2."Birth Country"='USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.ActorID) FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='Mrs. Doubtfire'
SELECT Name FROM actor WHERE ActorID=439 AND Gender='Male' AND Ethnicity='White'

SELECT T2.NetWorth, T2."Date of Birth" FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='Die Hard 2' AND T2."Height (Inches)" BETWEEN 60 AND 65

SELECT T3.Gross FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Genre='Comedy' AND T3.Rating<7 AND CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(T2.NetWorth,',',''),'$','') AS REAL)>375000000

SELECT T1."Character Name" FROM characters T1 JOIN actor T2 ON T1.ActorID=T2.ActorID JOIN movie T3 ON T3.MovieID=T1.MovieID WHERE T3.Title='Bruce Almighty' AND T2.Gender='Female' AND T2."Birth City"='Sherman Oaks' AND T2."Height (Inches)" > (SELECT AVG("Height (Inches)")*0.5 FROM actor)
